title: Plan
summary: The harvest comes down as twenty: forty casks in twenty days, moved up by a prefect with a season left before the College's letter lands, a Flamen staying to seal from the tenth day. Jonah counts: Collars pack matter because loricae cannot go near it, and nobody has thought about that since the year two hundred. He tells Pell: up the Throat in a cask as matter, the road to say he went into the wall. He takes the haul back and sees the loading gallery: forty casks cut from the Vein itself, a hundred and twelve slabs each, four hundred shards' weight; the Flamen seals from arm's length with the rod; the College prefers thirty-eight casks and a quiet Belt. Thirty to forty days to the Interior. He asks Tacitus, on the road, whether it can hold a man as matter for thirty days; it does the doorway thing and does not settle. The seal: carrying the seventh cask with his hand on the glass he feels the mark go into the lid and has it; it comes on the fourth try. The manifest: he talks Rennick, who has nothing left to fear, into writing the casks light in his own hand before the seal, then changes cask thirty-one from three ninety to two hundred and forty with his thumb, in Rennick's rhythm. The fourth thing: in the Cradle he asks the wall to show Tacitus how it held, and the plate goes in and closes around his heart before he has said when; he says when; it lets go. 'A dog doesn't stop.' Ulli names the fifth thing: somebody has to carry him to the Cradle sick and say in the morning that he went in, and it has to be the one who carries; and what has Jonah counted for Ulli when the College reads the road in two years? Nothing. 'Ask me on the fourteenth. I want to sit with it.' Grade about 32.
story_date: 394, spring, the sixth year, days 1 to 14 of the harvest

events.description: Decimus reads the harvest order: forty casks in twenty days, moved up by the College and the prefect; a Flamen staying to seal from the tenth day.
Jonah tells Pell the plan: up the Throat in a cask as matter, sealed, on a contractor's freighter; the road to say he went into the wall. 'I need three things and I've got one of them.'

Jonah takes the haul back and sees the loading gallery with Harrow: forty casks cut from the Vein, a hundred and twelve slabs each, four hundred shards' weight, sealed by a Flamen at arm's length with the rod; skimming expected; thirty to forty days to the Interior.
On the road Jonah asks Tacitus whether it can hold a man as matter for thirty days the way the box held it; it does the doorway thing and does not settle.

Tenth day: carrying the seventh cask with his palm on its glass, Jonah feels the harvest seal go into the lid through the cask and Tacitus has it; he drills it in the Cradle and it comes on the fourth try.

Twelfth day: Jonah talks Rennick into writing the casks light in his own hand before the seal; at the cage he changes cask thirty-one from three ninety to two hundred and forty with his thumb, in Rennick's rhythm and hesitation. Grade about 32 from feeding on harvest slabs.
Fourteenth night: in the Cradle Jonah asks the wall to show Tacitus how it held; Tacitus learns it and closes plate around his heart before he says when; he says when; it lets go. It worked.

Ulli names the fifth thing: somebody must carry him sick to the Cradle and say in the morning he went in, and it must be the one who carries; and Jonah has counted nothing for what happens to Ulli when the College reads the road in two years. 'Ask me on the fourteenth. I want to sit with it.'

thread_beats.description: Five things: the cask (thirty-one), the seal (from the palm), the slate (two hundred and forty in Rennick's hand), the holding (learned from the wall), and the one that comes out wrong: Ulli.
Does the deciding thing on the road; takes the seal through a cask; learns to hold a man from its mother and starts before it is told when; stops when told. 'A dog doesn't stop.'
Cursus step Hand: the manifest forged in Rennick's rhythm with his hesitation before a nine. Count: a frightened man counts casks, not the men who pack them.
Casks are the Vein hollowed because it eats through anything but itself; the wall shows Tacitus how it held.
He asks plainly and says when; the fifth thing he has not counted and admits it.
Ulli's song at the end of the road that is not for him.
'That's not a man. That's a dog.' 'No. A dog doesn't stop.'

clues.description: Casks are the Vein hollowed; the Vein eats through anything but itself.
clues.mechanism: Ch.32: Jonah breaks a cask from inside with Devour; the freighter's hold has nothing that can hold matter but casks.

clues.description: The Flamen seals at arm's length because the Vein wants the cutting in his arm.
clues.mechanism: Ch.29: the Flamen cannot come near the casks when it goes wrong; and the freighter's plated crew cannot handle open matter (ch.32).

clues.description: Rennick has stopped being afraid of Tullus because there is nothing left to be afraid of.
clues.mechanism: Rennick will be the one who does not raise the alarm at the count (ch.29).

clues.description: Tacitus started to hold him before he said when.
clues.mechanism: Ch.31: in the cask it holds him past when; the first word comes from inside the holding.

clues.description: Ulli's song at the end of the road that Jonah does not know and does not stop to learn.
clues.mechanism: Ch.27: it is the song Ulli sings over himself.

new_objects.name: The casks
new_objects.description: Forty casks cut and hollowed from the Vein a century ago, chest-high, a hundred and twelve slabs each. Cask thirty-one is Jonah's.

new_objects.name: The harvest manifest
new_objects.description: Rennick's slate: forty casks written light in his own hand; cask thirty-one altered by Jonah's thumb to two hundred and forty.
new_objects.significance: Covers a man's weight missing from a cask.

opening_hook: The harvest came down the Throat as a number, and the number was twenty.
closing_hook: Ulli sings a song that is not for him, and Jonah does not stop to learn it.
notes: Grade about 32. The five things: cask thirty-one, the seal, the manifest (240), the holding, and Ulli. Ch.27 is the fourteenth night's asking. Harrow stands in for Auger in ch.28 (he has a daughter on Marl per Auger's original sheet; transfer).
